qa_pair.question: Which of my Shelly devices are Gen1 versus Gen2?
qa_pair.answer: mycka is Gen1; televize, led, and svetla-kuchyn report via the Gen2+ model (televize and led are Gen2 hardware; the rest are Gen1 plugs). Tool: shelly_list_devices.

qa_pair.question: What is the total lifetime energy in kWh reported by the mycka plug?
qa_pair.answer: About 549 kWh. (Tool: shelly_energy_live / shelly_get_status on mycka; the cloud reports the Gen1 total already in Wh.)

qa_pair.question: Is the TV (televize) currently drawing power, and roughly how much?
qa_pair.answer: Yes, a small standby draw of about 0.6 W. Tool: shelly_energy_live on televize.

qa_pair.question: Which device runs on a DC voltage and what is it approximately?
qa_pair.answer: The led (Plus RGBW) runs on low-voltage DC, roughly 24 V. Tool: shelly_get_status / shelly_energy_live on led.

qa_pair.question: How many of my devices are on the 192.168.1.x subnet?
qa_pair.answer: Three (the two Gen1 plugs plus led). Tool: shelly_discover or shelly_list_devices (live/config dependent).

qa_pair.question: Which devices have a firmware update available, and on which channel?
qa_pair.answer: Depends on live state; typically led (beta) and mycka (beta) have updates available. Tool: shelly_get_info per device (sys.available_updates).

qa_pair.question: What components does the led device expose?
qa_pair.answer: An rgbw:0 light channel plus its input components. Tool: shelly_list_components on led.

qa_pair.question: Which device reports the highest internal (silicon) temperature right now?
qa_pair.answer: Live-dependent — compare temperature_c across devices. Tool: shelly_get_status on each (channel temperature.tC / device tmp).

qa_pair.question: Does the mycka plug report voltage and current?
qa_pair.answer: No. mycka is a Gen1 plug and reports power and energy only — voltage/current come back as null (None), not zero. Tool: shelly_energy_live on mycka.

qa_pair.question: What RGB colour is currently set on the led, and at what brightness?
qa_pair.answer: RGB approximately [255, 23, 47] at about 10% brightness. Tool: shelly_get_status on led (lights/rgbw:0).
